welcome.title: Let's set up your family
welcome.body: Let's set up Thuluth for your family. It takes about three minutes.
welcome.bismillahA11y: Bismillah ir-Rahman ir-Raheem: In the name of Allah, the Most Gracious, the Most Merciful
welcome.nameHelper: Your first name is enough. You can change it later in Settings.
welcome.nameError: Please enter a name of up to 40 characters.

philosophy.title: Eating in thirds
philosophy.body: Thuluth is built on a simple prophetic teaching about balance, not restriction.
philosophy.thirdsA11y: A stomach divided into three equal parts: one third for food, one third for drink, one third for breath.

hadith.label: Hadith
hadith.translation: “The son of Adam fills no vessel worse than his stomach. It is sufficient for the son of Adam to eat a few morsels to keep his back straight. If he must, then one third for his food, one third for his drink and one third for his breath.”

philosophy.plateA11y: A plate divided into half vegetables, a quarter protein and a quarter whole grains.
philosophy.childrenBody: Thuluth never counts calories or sets weight-loss goals for children. For them, we focus on growth, variety and enjoying meals together.

tradition.label: Which sources should we draw on?
tradition.hint: You can change this at any time in Settings.
tradition.sharedDescription: Quran and narrations accepted across traditions.
tradition.sunniDescription: Bukhari, Muslim, Tirmidhi and the other Sunni collections.
tradition.shiaDescription: Al-Kafi and the other Shia collections.

consents.title: Your privacy
consents.body: Before you add any family details, please review how we use your data.
consents.summary: Your family's data is private to your household. We never sell it. You can export or delete it at any time.
consents.ready: Thank you. You can change optional choices later in Settings.
consents.requiredNote: Please tick every required item to continue.

age.title: I am 18 or older
age.description: Accounts are for adults. You can add children as family members.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How we collect, store and protect your data.

health_data.title: Health information
health_data.description: Store family health details such as age, height, weight and conditions to personalise meal plans.

ai_processing.title: AI assistance
ai_processing.description: Let our AI service process your family details to suggest meals and answer questions. Data is not used to train models.

marketing.title: Tips and updates (optional)
marketing.description: Occasional emails about new features and healthy-eating tips.

childConsent.title: Consent for children's data
childConsent.body: You're adding a child. As their parent or guardian, please confirm that you consent to Thuluth storing their details for this household.
childConsent.agree: I am this child's parent or guardian and I consent

household.title: Your household
household.body: Tell us where you live so prices, seasons and prayer times fit your family.
household.name: Household name
household.budgetHelper: Optional. We'll plan meals within this amount.

errors.timezoneInvalid: Enter a valid time zone, such as Asia/Karachi.
errors.budgetInvalid: Enter an amount using numbers only.

members.title: Who's in your family?
members.body: Add everyone you cook for, including yourself. You can add more later.
members.noHousehold: We couldn't find your household. Go back and create it first.
members.needOne: Add at least one family member to continue.
